name: BRL1
oneLiner: BRL1 is a centralized Brazilian real stablecoin, targeting a 1:1 peg with a BRL reserve mix of Brazilian Treasury ETFs, repo agreements, and cash equivalents.
collateral: Brazilian-real reserve portfolio backing BRL1 at a 1:1 target, including Brazilian Treasury ETFs, repo agreements, and cash equivalents
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption route designed to maintain 1 BRL1 = 1 BRL through Brazilian-real backing

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

reserves.name: Brazilian Treasury ETFs, repo agreements, and cash equivalents

params.label: Brazilian Treasury ETFs, repo agreements, and cash equivalents

mintAuthority.summary: BRL1 is issued by a consortium of Brazilian exchanges (Bitso, Mercado Bitcoin, Foxbit, Cainvest); whitelisted institutional partners deposit BRL via PIX to mint and redeem 1:1 through the issuer backend against a BRL reserve portfolio.

controls.label: BRL1 consortium issuance backend
controls.evidence: Mint/burn restricted to whitelisted institutional partners who deposit BRL via PIX; the consortium backend creates BRL1 supply against custodied BRL reserves. No permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.

review.evidence: BRL1 materials describe issuance by a consortium of Bitso, Mercado Bitcoin, Foxbit, and Cainvest, with mint/redeem limited to whitelisted institutional clients against BRL reserves; Fact Finance provides proof of reserves.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Issuer/consortium model established from project materials; the on-chain Polygon token owner/minter admin was not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain Polygon token owner/minter admin (0x5c06...40b5) and any proxy admin before raising confidence.
